errata.reason: Cash-quality qualification (2026-11-11): the approximately 90% normalized CFO/EBITDA carried from earnings/06 through earnings/99 is a timing sensitivity, not an established estimate of sustainable operating cash. The saved calculation subtracts USD4,642m = USD4,592m increase in deferred revenues from customer prepayments with a significant financing component + USD50m increase in other deferred revenues (both filed cash-flow movements) from reported CFO of USD31,977m, leaving USD27,335m; division by the saved vendor-derived EBITDA of USD30,494m gives 89.6%. Unusual size does not establish nonrecurrence, and recurring advance funding does not establish earned, unrestricted surplus cash. The saved vendor EBITDA definition was not independently verified in this review; do not relabel it as a filing-based or standardized EBITDA measure. Keep the adjustment definition, vendor denominator and this uncertainty with the ratio. Reported FCF of USD-23,686m remains unchanged; no replacement normalized figure, score or investment action is asserted.
